tools.name: ask_hey
tools.title: Ask HEY
tools.description: Asking something else about one project? Put it in free text, by slug, in English or Malay ("did they ship this month?"). HEY answers only from its record, every line tagged FACT, DERIVED or UNKNOWN with its source. Building only; no view on price.

question.description: The question, in the reader's words.

tools.name: chain_overview
tools.title: Robinhood Chain overview
tools.description: How active is Robinhood Chain? view: days (default; ships and builders per day, then market context), this-week, weekly-report (an ISO week, or the latest), unlocks (scheduled HoodLock unlocks with proof), build-market (Build Momentum beside market attention). days names no one; other views name projects.

tools.name: explain_fact
tools.title: Explain a fact
tools.description: Why does HEY say a project is Shipping, Dormant or Still Building, or show a figure? The value, FACT, DERIVED or UNKNOWN, the rule and version, the winning source, the inputs, the lineage and the evidence ids. Omit fact to list what can be explained; source.counted takes a source id. build.change explains one change (event=<ledger id>, or the latest): its stage, who reported it, any exact release↔deployment link, what HEY does not know.

fact.description: The fact to explain; omit to list them.

event.description: With fact=build.change: a change-ledger id; omit for the latest.

tools.name: find_projects
tools.title: Find a Robinhood Chain project
tools.description: Which Robinhood Chain project is this name, $TICKER or 0x contract, and is anyone building it? A full 0x address is a contract lookup: its ships in 30 days, the last one with its source. Or browse who is shipping now, back from dormancy, accelerating or building ahead of market attention. Surfaces: building-with-token: shipping, active or resumed, with a token whose market is live. still-building: counted ships during a market drawdown HEY itself tracked. under-the-radar: eligible under HEY's Under the Radar rule (status shipping, active or resumed; Build Momentum at least 30; at least 2 counted ships in the last 30 days, one of them a ship rather than a commit summary; a fresh reading of an active market beyond a launch curve or a launch pool, trading $1,000+ a day, for the project's own token; market attention TYPICAL or lower (percentile below 60); never on activity HEY cannot read or a ticker another project's token carries, on a token the project has not named) and a positive Discovery Gap — market-attention percentile below the build percentile; a positive gap alone is not enough. shipping-now: status SHIPPING. most-active: shipping, active or resumed, by Build Momentum. new-builders: new in 7 days, with a builder source and a counted ship; new-on-hey: any page new in 7 days. back-from-dormancy: status RESUMED, narrowed to Verified Builders native to the chain (status=RESUMED gives all of them). utility, memes: by kind. shipping-in-silence: held Under the Radar AND below the 40th market-attention percentile. accelerating: more counted ships in 30 days than in the 30 before. builder-radar: the Builder Radar, by counted development, on-chain use and research, never price. shipping-in-silence and accelerating take no other argument (at most 100 rows); builder-radar: query, radar, limit, offset. Not a ranking by price: a market sort is context, and rows without the figure follow in activity order.

surface.description: A list to browse (see the tool description); omit to search or filter the whole catalogue.

minLiquidity.description: USD; unknown is excluded, never zero.

maxMarketCap.description: USD, on the card's valuation reading.

minMarketCap.description: USD, on the card's valuation reading.

sort.description: Default activity; shipped = newest ship first; shipped7d / shipped30d = most meaningful ships in the last 7 / 30 days.

offset.description: The offset a previous answer gave.

tools.name: get_changes
tools.title: What changed on Robinhood Chain
tools.description: What changed on Robinhood Chain today or this week, or for one project or contract? The change ledger: releases, ships, status moves, contract deploys and upgrades, verification, sources, unlocks — one event per change with its own time and precision, when HEY first knew, and its evidence. Newest first by first arrival; for today pass detectedSince; to sync, pass after=c1.0 and keep each cursor. A retraction means HEY no longer makes that claim. Facts, never causes.

since.description: ISO date: events whose own time is at or after it (events with no source time are left out).

until.description: ISO date: events whose own time is before it.

detectedSince.description: ISO instant: start a sync at the first event HEY recorded at or after it.

after.description: Sync forward from this cursor (c1.0 is the start).

tools.name: get_contract
tools.title: Who made this contract
tools.description: Who made this Robinhood Chain contract, and is it a known project's? Project, creation, deployer (the only account named, with a count of other tracked projects' tokens it deployed), published source code and whose code it is (template, bytecode match or its own), Sourcify's answer, proxy and implementation history, interface changes, 7 days of calls per method (counts, names withheld; a selector's signature candidate — a guess, never a name). Address (chainId default 4663) or slug for all of a project's. An unread proxy is "not read", never "not a proxy". Not a safety verdict.

address.description: A 0x contract address; or give slug.

slug.description: A project slug, for all of its contracts.

tools.name: get_evidence
tools.title: Open evidence
tools.description: What backs this claim? Open the record a HEY answer cited by its typed id — ship:, signal:, abi:, impl:, lock:, source:, claim:, state:, integrity:, narrative:, method:, sourcechange:, security:, v4hook:, v4pool:, ponsgrad: — as a receipt: what it claims, its source URL, when it happened at what precision, when HEY knew, how it is backed. A withdrawn record says so.

tools.name: get_project_snapshot
tools.title: Project snapshot
tools.description: Where does this Robinhood Chain project stand? One read by slug — the Research Summary, identity, activity status and Build Momentum, last ships, market context with its kind or why it is withheld, on-chain use, 7-day usage (calls; caller addresses per day, not people), verification, HoodLock locks, latest changes with evidence ids, freshness and what HEY does not know. Context blocks, never building: paid promotion (presence and dates), DefiLlama protocol economics (measured, not tracked or unread), developer footprint. Not price advice.

tools.name: get_project_timeline
tools.title: What a project shipped
tools.description: What did this project ship, and when? Builds, releases, code, contract deploys, upgrades and interface changes, token verification, locks and unlocks, each with how precisely HEY knows its time. Lenses: everything, build, code, onchain, market, locks. Paged with the before cursor.

before.description: The cursor the previous answer gave.

tools.name: get_token_market
tools.title: Token market
tools.description: Does this token still trade? Context beside the building, from HEY's daily index: current reading (valuation kind, provider), price, liquidity, volume and trades by day, lifecycle (deploy, launchpad claim, stage, first trade, launch graduation, permanent lock), pools and depth, supply concentration (shares only, no addresses), contract checks. include=["moves"] adds each day-on-day valuation move with the building events published before it — a sequence, never a cause. Not price advice.

min_change_pct.description: With moves: smallest move in percent; default 25.

tools.name: get_v4_hook
tools.title: Uniswap v4 hook
tools.description: Who built this Robinhood Chain Uniswap v4 hook? The project HEY ties it to and why (named only while listed; never a creator account), declared callbacks (not a safety verdict), source, hooklist entry, pools by week and unknowns.

tools.name: market_integrity
tools.title: Market integrity
tools.description: What happened to this project's tracked token market — liquidity against the level it held, trading, a pool migration — beside its builder activity, and where do the two disagree? It describes the token market, never whether development stopped, and never calls a project a rug or safe.

tools.name: project_diff
tools.title: Project diff
tools.description: What changed for this project between two dates (YYYY-MM-DD, at most 400 days apart)? Releases and meaningful ships, status, Build Momentum, valuation and liquidity then and now, and the changes recorded — each from the nearest persisted point with its date and basis. Never a cause.

to.description: End day, YYYY-MM-DD; at most 400 days after from.

tools.name: research_answer
tools.title: Research a Robinhood Chain project
tools.description: Is this Robinhood Chain project still being built, what did it ship, what changed, is this contract its own? One cited answer. capability: research_project or builder_status (q: a name or $TICKER, or address, or project: a slug; a shared name lists candidates); what_changed (project or chain, 1–30 days); verify_project (address, project?); compare_builders (2–4, no winner); unknowns (every coverage state). Claims FACT/DERIVED/UNKNOWN with evidence ids; not_found is a status, not isError. Not price advice or a safety verdict.

capability.description: Which answer; each takes the arguments the tool description names.

q.description: A name or $TICKER; a shared name lists candidates, never a guess.

address.description: A 0x contract address on Robinhood Chain.

types.description: what_changed: change types to keep, e.g. build.release.

limit.description: what_changed: events shown, default 25; the total is the whole window.

building.description: what_changed: only events that count as building.

detail.description: Default summary text; full text; compact drops the capability data from the JSON.
